goal.objective: Activate and continuously advance the stable non-authorizing StegGate rendezvous through the single StegVerse heartbeat until live acceptance passes; any unavailable third-party deployment path triggers an alternate solution/workaround and may never become a StegVerse blocker.
success_predicates: The worker is atomically claimed and heartbeat-timed in the canonical worker registry.
Any unavailable third-party credential, provider capability, quota, outage, or deployment path returns ACTIVE/THIRD_PARTY_WORKAROUND_REQUIRED rather than BLOCKED.
At least one admitted deployment path is selected and advanced without waiting for a third-party condition to change.
Only the canonical Site rendezvous source blob is deployed.
The stable route passes readiness, canonical health, and exact ALLOW/DENY/REVIEW/FAIL_CLOSED self-test.
No credential value is persisted in repository state or receipts.
failure_predicates: A third-party dependency is represented as BLOCKED.
The worker repeatedly rechecks a provider condition without selecting a workaround.
Heartbeat availability is treated as deployment authority.
Mutable/unverified Site worker source is deployed.
Deployment success is treated as live acceptance without probes.
Credential values are written to repository state or receipts.

task.derivation_reason: Unresolved rendezvous work is heartbeat-worker managed. Cloudflare is an optional deployment path only; external provider state is never an unresolved task dependency.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while task remains unfinished; third-party condition repeats must advance workaround selection rather than repeat blocker observation

completion.next_authorized_action: Attempt the admitted Cloudflare path only when immediately usable; otherwise select and advance an admitted StegVerse-owned/federated or other non-provider-dependent rendezvous path and prove stable live acceptance.
terminal_when: Worker returns COMPLETED with transition LIVE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
Stable readiness and health are externally observable
Self-test proves ALLOW, DENY, REVIEW, and FAIL_CLOSED
Completion evidence contains no credential values
No third-party service is required for continued StegVerse progress
